column3: What it is / why it matters

What fellow retailers in the same block bought this month, broken out by specific product — not just an amount. Each product carries its Category (e.g. Crop Protection), Business Segment (e.g. PRIVATE LABEL), Business Category, and Brand — confirmed schema: coupon_analysis / sale_orderrequestline joined to products_template. This is what tells the SE WHICH exact product to recommend, not just a generic peer-benchmark number.

Category_Name, Sub_Category_Name, Business_Segment_Name (= 'PRIVATE LABEL' for PL), Business_Category, Product_Brand — attached to every product mentioned anywhere in a pitch (S1, S2, S3, S8), so the SE never names a bare product without its category/segment context.
This DC's own discount on its last invoice for a specific product — sale_orderrequestline.discount_price_unit. Confirmed: null means no discount was given, never treat as ₹0.

The recommended discount for this visit, computed by combining this DC's own discount history (coupon_analysis) with the Same Block Purchase pattern (S1) — i.e. what discount is working for comparable DCs in the same block, on the same product. Confirmed methodology, not a flat system default.
This DC's own buying/selling pattern over time — used to spot preference, cycle, and payment behavior.
